slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: 夜幕笼罩下，一座塔楼悬浮于夜空中，塔顶幽蓝的魔火将流动的光晕投射在云层之上，与漫天星辰交相辉映。
浮空塔下方是一排排装修精致的哥特式建筑，其中一座庄园的空地上，两个人影在月光下缠斗。
两个身影相互试探，不断地变换步伐，铁木制成的木剑在手掌的灵活操作下不断变换。
巨响过后，一把木剑从大骑士宽大厚实的手掌中掉落。
“正式骑士已经不是少爷的对手了。”
奥洛·克里昂甩了甩略微僵硬的手掌，开口赞赏道。
“自从那次事件后，少爷的变化可真大。”
这位大骑士身着装饰精美的重型盔甲，盔甲表面刻着许多符文。
银白色的符文在盔甲上泛着微光，这些符文给盔甲增加了些许魔抗，使其能防护一些零级魔法。
他仿佛一座移动的城堡，宽厚的胸膛如城墙般坚实，呼吸间都似有雷霆震动。
但其脸上略显苍老的痕迹挥之不去，头发已渐渐向白色转变。
大骑士的寿命一般在200岁左右，当然，常年征战积累的暗伤使部分大骑士的寿命远低于此。
而谁能想到，这位曾被称为“破晓之剑”
的王室护卫长已经二百有余。
这位守卫了卡维亚王室100余年的巅峰大骑士在暮年毅然与一位来王室执行任务的巫师学徒签订了终生契约，并在这位巫师学徒的帮助下移植了山妖的心脏。
这种生物的表皮如同山上的岩石，其心脏蕴含强横的生命力，能大大提升了这位大骑士的寿命。
但因其心脏太过坚硬，虽然经过巫师学徒的粗糙改造，但其泵血能力依旧略有不足。
其血液需要大量矿物质，但他并不能像山妖一样食用矿物、岩石，只能定期注射矿物浓缩剂。
至于那位移植技术不太熟练巫师学徒正是如今克雷格家族的族长，三级巫师学徒默瑞·克雷格。
不过，严格意义上讲，克雷格家族已经并不算巫师家族，毕竟如今的克雷格家族只剩三位三等巫师学徒。
分别是家主默瑞·克雷格和他的两个弟弟默迪·克雷格和默斯·克雷格。
至于克雷格家族的正式巫师，在默瑞这一代就断掉了，克雷格三兄弟的资质并不是很好，最高的也只有中等的三等资质。
虽然一级正式巫师的寿命可达七百岁，但他们的长辈早年死于学院斗争。
并没有留下太多宝贵的正式巫师级别的资源和知识，三兄弟的巫师之路似乎只能止步于此。
克雷格家族目前只能算是在由巫师在大陆西边建立的一座巫师城邦——“科瑞拉”
中买了房产的高级居民。
而家族联盟则是由大陆中心的五大巫师氏族组成的联盟金环冕章”
分别在大陆中心周围的主要巫师城邦设立的分部。
各大家族的珍贵资源和消息优先在各大家族联盟间交易。
加入议会的巫师家族，若其子嗣有五等资质，则经过考核后可直接去大陆中心的巫师学院学习享受更好的资源。
事实上，大陆中心以外的各大高级巫师学院就是大陆中心巫师学院的分部。
content_en:
Under the cover of night, a tower is suspended in the night sky. The blue magic fire on the top of the tower projects a flowing halo above the clouds, interspersing with the stars in the sky.
Below the floating tower are rows of exquisitely decorated Gothic buildings. In the open space of one of the manors, two figures were fighting in the moonlight.
The two figures tested each other, constantly changing their steps, and the wooden sword made of ironwood kept changing under the flexible operation of the palms.
"Bang——!"
After the loud noise, a wooden sword fell from the broad and thick palm of the great knight.
"A formal knight is no longer a match for the young master."
Orlo Creon shook his slightly stiff palms and spoke in appreciation.
"Since that incident, the young master has changed so much."
The high knight wore richly decorated heavy armor with many runes engraved on its surface.
Silver-white runes shimmered on the armor. These runes added some magic resistance to the armor, allowing it to protect against some zero-level magic.
He was like a moving castle, his broad chest as solid as a city wall, and his breath seemed to be vibrating with thunder.
But there are lingering traces of aging on his face, and his hair has gradually turned white.
The lifespan of a great knight is generally about 200 years old. Of course, the hidden injuries accumulated in years of battles make the lifespan of some great knights much lower than this.
And who would have thought that this man was once called the "Sword of the Dawn"
There are already more than 200 royal guards.
In his later years, this peak knight who had guarded the Kaweiya royal family for more than 100 years resolutely signed a lifelong contract with a wizard apprentice who came to the royal family to perform a mission, and with the help of the wizard apprentice, he transplanted the heart of the mountain demon.
The skin of this creature is like a rock on a mountain, and its heart contains powerful vitality, which can greatly extend the life of this great knight.
However, because its heart is too hard, its ability to pump blood is still slightly insufficient despite being roughly modified by the wizard's apprentice.
Its blood requires a large amount of minerals, but it cannot eat minerals or rocks like the troll, and can only inject mineral concentrates regularly.
As for the wizard apprentice who is not very skilled in transplantation technology, he is now the patriarch of the Craig family, the third-level wizard apprentice Murray Craig.
However, strictly speaking, the Craig family is no longer a wizarding family. After all, there are only three third-class wizard apprentices left in the Craig family.
They are the head of the family, Murray Craig, and his two younger brothers, Murdy Craig and Merce Craig.
As for the official wizards of the Craig family, they were discontinued in Murray's generation. The qualifications of the three Craig brothers are not very good, and the highest one only has a moderate third-class qualification.
Although the first-level official wizards can live up to seven hundred years old, their elders died early in the academy's struggles.
Not many valuable official wizard-level resources and knowledge were left behind, and the three brothers' journey as wizards seemed to stop there.
The Craig family can currently only be regarded as living in a wizarding city-state established by wizards in the west of the continent - "Corella"
Senior residents who have bought real estate.
The family alliance is an alliance composed of the five major wizard clans in the center of the continent."
Branches were established in the major wizarding city-states around the center of the continent.
The precious resources and information of each major family will be traded among the major family alliances first.
If the descendants of a wizard family that joins the parliament have fifth-level qualifications, they can directly go to the wizard academy in the center of the continent to study and enjoy better resources after passing the assessment.
In fact, all major high-level wizarding colleges outside the Continent Center are branches of the Continental Center Wizarding Academy.
